guard: a post-join notice refused because the resumed session is mid-turn is recorded and swallowed, so the seat that already joined survives it
why: Rethrowing from the post-join notice catch ends the already-joined host. The first no-inbox startup scenario now runs before the later mesh-work scenario, so its kickoff-delivery assertion is the first failure. The mutation retains the original rethrow and names that observed assertion. This fail-fast mutation stops at the startup assertion and does not independently mutation-grade the later mesh-work assertion; that behavior remains covered by the unmutated host smoke.

mutations.name: the refused post-join notice is fatal to the launch again
mutations.expectRed: idle completion delivers the startup kickoff without any inbox wake
mutations.cell: idle completion delivers the startup kickoff without any inbox wake
